_comment: Intentionally invalid DNP3 mapping examples — for documentation and testing reference only. Each route demonstrates a specific validation error. This file is NOT a valid mapping config and will be rejected by Dnp3MappingConfig.from_dict().

routes._error: INVALID: unrecognized DNP3 operation 'WRITE_FREEZE' — only READ, SELECT, OPERATE, DIRECT_OPERATE, CONTROL, ENABLE_UNSOLICITED, and '*' are accepted

routes.name: invalid-action

routes._error: INVALID: resource_type is empty — must be a non-empty string
routes.name: empty-resource-type

routes._error: INVALID: resource_id_template references {value} — command values are evidence, never resource identity
routes.name: value-in-template

routes._error: INVALID: malformed template token '{outstation_id' — missing closing brace
routes.name: malformed-template

routes._error: INVALID: control route does not reference {point_index} — control commands must identify the controlled point
routes.name: control-without-point-index
